scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,server,client "npm run dev -w @web-pazle/shared" "npm run dev -w @web-pazle/server" "npm run dev -w @web-pazle/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @web-pazle/shared && npm run build -w @web-pazle/server && npm run build -w @web-pazle/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @web-pazle/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.predev: npm run build -w @web-pazle/shared && npm run build -w @web-pazle/server
